research.ask: "homes_by_decade" — the age of {city}'s housing stock, as an object whose keys are exactly "Before 1960", "1960-1979", "1980-1999", "2000-2009", "2010 or later" and whose values are the plain-number PERCENTAGE of homes built in each period, adding to about 100
research.source_ask: "homes_by_decade_source" — the source of those housing figures (e.g. "US Census ACS 2019-2023 5-year estimates")

captions: Much of the housing in {city}, {SS} is not new: the largest share was built {peak}. Older supply lines, water heaters and shut-off valves fail more often and with less warning.
The biggest slice of {city}'s housing stock dates from {peak}. Plumbing of that age is the single most common source of sudden indoor water damage.
In {city}, homes built {peak} make up the largest group at {peak_value} of the stock — old enough that original plumbing is often still in place.
